## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `629e77d4b9534cc0afb3aa907a288b15ebdd6810`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card objectui#12213 (body and its four comments: triage `6121900859`, claim `6122167210`, dev report `6123163546`, seat `6123212511`); PR objectui#12236 (body, 14-file list, net diff against `main`); the 44 check-runs on the head: 41 success, 3 skipped (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)`, the coverage shard matrix, none of which runs on a PR), 0 failure, 0 pending. Base files read from `origin/main` by `git show` only. Nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. `@object-ui/types` `BaseFieldMetadata`: `help?: string` removed, `inlineHelpText?: SpecField['inlineHelpText']` added by reference to `@objectstack/spec/data`. RIGHT. The spec's `FieldSchema` declares `inlineHelpText` ("Help text displayed below the field in forms") and lists `help`, `helpText`, `hint` and `tooltip` as refused aliases of it; Studio's `ObjectFieldInspector` commits `patchDef({ inlineHelpText })`. The TypeScript authoring face now accepts for this key exactly what the publish door accepts. Pinned both ways in `field-metadata-inline-help-text-12213.test.ts` (type-level `_NoHelpOnAnyFieldType` over the whole `FieldMetadata` union, runtime `FieldSchema.safeParse` on the installed spec). The `Field as SpecField` import already existed for `FieldDependsOn`, so no new coupling.
2. Record form read: `ObjectForm`'s own builder and `fromObjectSchema` share one read, `fieldHelpText` in `sectionFields.ts`: `inlineHelpText || help || description || undefined`. RIGHT on the spec key first. The `||` choice is right: the spec declares no setting that hides the help line and Studio stores a cleared box as no key, so `??` would have made the empty string an undeclared way to blank the description. `fieldHelpText` and `FieldHelpTextSource` are package-internal: `packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx` is untouched and re-exports only `sectionEntryName` from `sectionFields`. No public-surface change in plugin-form.
3. The retained `help` leg (step 2 of the read) is the status quo, not a new fallback: both builders read `field.help || field.description` at the base. It is now typed on the local `FieldHelpTextSource`, not on the authoring face, with its one producer named (an objectstack server on spec 17.6.x or older, whose translator wrote the translated description onto `help`). Keeping it is what triage's direction required once the measurement found a served producer ("that leg is reported before it is removed"). Whether it retires is before the ruler (③.1); not decided here.
4. `@object-ui/fields` `resolveActionParam`: `helpText: param.helpText ?? (field.inlineHelpText || field.help || field.description || undefined)`. RIGHT. The param's own `helpText` keeps precedence (an empty param `helpText` still wins through `??`, as before); the field-backed fallback follows the record form's order. `RuntimeField` is a module-private interface (declared without `export`, nothing in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` names it), so adding `inlineHelpText?: string` to it is no public-surface change. Pinned through the real dialog in `ActionParamDialog.fieldHelpLine-12213.test.tsx`.
5. Docs: `auto-number`, `file`, `object` and `text` now teach `inlineHelpText`. RIGHT, and complete: on `origin/main` those four were the only `help:` field literals under `content/docs/**`; package READMEs and `skills/**` carry none (my grep agrees with the dev's D7).
6. Correctly untouched: `FlowNodeConfigField`'s `field.help` reads `FlowConfigField` (`flow-node-config.ts`: `id`, `path`, `kind`, `label`, `help`), an inspector config descriptor, not field metadata (D3 confirmed from the declaration). `BulkActionParam.help` in `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` is a bulk-action param's own key, and the four plugin-grid fixtures spelling `help:` are that type; neither is field metadata nor in the card's scope. Flow screens (`ScreenView`) already draw `inlineHelpText`.
7. Placement (D4): `FormDescription` after `FormControl`, bound through `aria-describedby`, pinned by role on the flat, sectioned and tabbed layouts, the same place flow screens draw it. RIGHT. The file-field size hint (D5) still follows the help text on the flat builder; pinned.
8. One prose defect, not a contract defect: the new JSDoc on `BaseFieldMetadata.inlineHelpText` says the record form reads it through "`fieldHelpText` in `@object-ui/fields`"; the helper lives in `@object-ui/plugin-form`'s `sectionFields`. This text ships in the published `.d.ts`. Non-blocking; the fix rides the follow-up PR this card will produce (③.1), which edits the same region.

### ② Semver level

- PR body: `Clause-②: yes` at line start. RIGHT. `BaseFieldMetadata` is an exported interface with no index signature; adding `inlineHelpText` widens the authoring face and removing `help` narrows it. Both arms occur, so writing no single `(widening)` or `(narrowing)` arm is the correct form for a mixed change. Triage's `no` was overturned by the claim's reasoning, which this review confirms.
- `.changeset/12213-types-inline-help-text.md`: `@object-ui/types` `minor`. RIGHT. A `yes` takes at least `minor`; the narrowing is breaking and is stated as such, with FROM `help?: string` TO `inlineHelpText`, the one-line fix (rename, value unchanged), and the fixed-group policy that prices objectui's own breaks as `minor` (objectui AGENTS.md §9; `major` is refused by `check-changeset-no-major`). The body also carries the Clause-② line.
- `.changeset/12213-plugin-form-inline-help-text.md`: `patch`. RIGHT: behaviour fix, no exported-surface change. FROM and TO stated.
- `.changeset/12213-fields-action-param-help.md`: `patch`. RIGHT: behaviour fix, `RuntimeField` private. FROM and TO stated.
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: one test file only, no changeset owed; `check-changeset-presence` counts 7 source files of 4 released packages against 3 changesets, consistent.
- Gate verdicts on the head: Changeset Declaration, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Overwrite Report, Changeset Claim Re-read, Doc Snippet Type Check, Type Check, Lint, all 8 test shards, dist pins, Build and E2E: success. objectui has no ADR-0087 changeset-marker gate (that rule is objectstack's), so none is owed here.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. `open_questions[0]`, the served `help` READ leg (step 2 of `fieldHelpText` and of the resolver's field-backed `helpText`): retire now (A), keep until a named server floor (B), fold at ingestion (C, shown not viable). ESCALATED: already put to the ruler on the card by the seat (comment `6123212511`, `needs-user-decision`, seat recommends A). This PR ships B as the status quo, typed on local interfaces only, so the ruling's deletion touches two readers and two local members and no public surface. The PR's first line is `Part of #12213`, so the card stays open as the decision's anchor, and the merge decides nothing either way. Not decided here.
2. Deviation, route: the order is spelled in two places, `fieldHelpText` (plugin-form) and the resolver (fields), because `@object-ui/fields` cannot import `@object-ui/plugin-form` and a new fields module plus an `index.tsx` export was outside the claim's file list (stop on breach). ANSWERED: the reason stands, and the two form builders triage named do share one read. Note for the ruling's PR: whichever arm is ruled, both sites change together; that is the moment to lift the one read into `@object-ui/fields` (plugin-form already depends on it) so the order has one home.
3. D1, the fold: `normalizeSchemaReferenceKeys` does not stamp `help` (no declared twin; `display_field` as the control). ANSWERED, consistent with the spec's alias table naming `help` only as refusal guidance toward `inlineHelpText`.
4. D2 (dialog), D4 (placement), D5 (size hint), D6 (`||`): ANSWERED, each pinned, each judged right in ①.
5. D3 (`FlowNodeConfigField`): ANSWERED, confirmed from `FlowConfigField`'s declaration.
6. D7 (`skills/**`): ANSWERED, 0 hits; my grep agrees.
7. app-shell test added with no changeset: RIGHT, test-only.
8. `out_of_scope_findings`: (a) the same docs literals carry other keys `FieldSchema` refuses (`pattern`, `pattern_message`, `starting_number`, `schema`; `auto_number` and `object` as `type` values): reported to the PM for the family's closing card, not this PR's; ESCALATED as the dev did. (b) `ObjectFormCanvas` draws `def.description` only (confirmed on `origin/main`), so after this PR a field carrying both shows different text on the Studio canvas and on the record form; the report lists no carrier. ESCALATED to the owning seat to card: the PR makes the divergence visible. (c) a stale comment in plugin-detail's `buildDefaultPageSchema` naming `ObjectFieldLike.help`, and (d) the size hint appended by the flat builder only, pre-existing: noted, not blocking.
9. ①.8, the JSDoc naming the wrong package for `fieldHelpText`: carried to the follow-up PR on this card.
